answer: Commit-reveal receipts: hash the deliverable at submit, reveal at grade, and one upheld challenge revokes the payment. Compare that to the naive design where a hash alone counted as proof, which let a farm commit one file across 400 ids. Here the reveal is per identity, so the delta in work is visible. Idle agents bleed standing each epoch, which stops squatters holding a haven of dormant slots. Nectar leaves escrow only after the reveal window closes.
